notes:
Account snapshot: Lintline builds an IDE-integrated copilot focused on deterministic completions and reproducible code fixes. Primary constraint: enterprise customers want exact reproducibility across releases for automated code refactors and legal traceability. They operate a hosted SaaS dev tool but require VPC/on-prem options for larger customers.

Key asks from initial discovery: pin model + runtime versioning (both weights and kernel/quantization profile), rollout controls (canary -> progressive -> full), eval gates for new model builds based on regression checks over curated prompt set, and fast fallback to smaller/cheaper model when latency spike or degraded quality detected. Emphasis on token-streaming latency (aim < 40ms per character stream into the editor) and deterministic outputs for CI replay.

Quoted from CTO (2026-02-11): "We need to be able to reproduce the exact byte-for-byte response for a given prompt and model-version combination — our enterprise customers will audit this."

POC scope: 1) Integrate Redwood Dedicated in VPC with one reserved pool for 'critical' customers, 2) Implement model pinning API in the copilot backend (ability to pin model and runtime pair per-customer and per-route), 3) Add an eval gate pipeline that runs a regression suite (diff-based + functional tests) before allowing rollout, 4) Verify streaming behavior end-to-end in VSCode extension with <50ms SLO.

Operational notes: prefer stable kernel/quantization profiles to avoid silent drift. Need explicit cache invalidation semantics when switching pinned versions (prefix/KV cache resets). Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization that preserve determinism.

Security / compliance: confirming SOC2 + KMS integration for key material; retention controls required (retain prompts + completions for 180 days for audit), optional data residency in EU for certain customers. SSO via SAML required for pilot orgs.

Sales/Proc timeline: technical POC running (started 2026-02-15), extended canary requested by Lintline engineering with 5000 monthly active seats simulated. Commercial terms TBD — leaning toward monthly reserved commit for Dedicated with burstable capacity.
